issues.reason: A relational noun's of-phrase is routed to the ordinary genitive by the instruction set itself ('a tributary of the larger river' is 'the ordinary genitive of Possessive / genitive NP'), and Possession is opaque — 'a static genitive asserts a link ... without having to mean ownership' — so the possessed-first atom, matching the surface, asserts no false belonging.

Recovering the relation by joining the Member and Possession atoms on the shared symbol is the sanctioned genitive decomposition, exactly as 'her sister' stores (Member sk_sister_1 sister) plus (Possession sk_sister_1 <her>).

gaps_confirmed: event/result nominalization with an of-complement naming its argument ('a generalization of X', 'the destruction of the city', 'a photo of Mary') has no prescribed encoding
notes: 'Generalization of X' patterns with the relational-noun genitive (the 'X has a generalization' paraphrase holds), not with the excluded aboutness case 'a photo of Mary', so the improvisation stays inside licensed precedent.
